title: FanDuel admits it has used roughly 30 Bryce Harper-style videos

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: FanDuel admits it has used roughly 30 Bryce Harper-style videos
sources.description: In July, Phillies first baseman Bryce Harper stepped into a pile of No. 2, thanks to a personalized video purchased by FanDuel in order to ensure that a valued customer (i.e., a consistent loser) would keep losing.
